manifest.name: Coupons, Promotions, Gift Card and Loyalty for eCommerce
manifest.summary: Use coupon, promotion, gift cards and loyalty programs in your eCommerce store

models._description: Create links that apply a coupon and redirect to a specific page

behavioral_notes.observation: When a shopper enters a promo/coupon code, the overridden WebsiteSale.pricelist controller calls order_sudo._try_apply_code(promo) (defined in sale_loyalty). That base method resolves the code to a loyalty.rule (program) or a loyalty.card coupon under the website-scoped _get_trigger_domain/_get_program_domain -- this module swaps the 'sale_ok' leaf for 'ecommerce_ok' and AND-adds a website_id filter so only ecommerce-published, website-matching programs apply -- then row-locks loyalty_program (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT) to serialize concurrent carts, rejects loyalty/ewallet programs from code entry, appends any coupon to applied_coupon_ids, and returns {'error'/'not_found'} or a {coupon: rewards} dict. The website layer adds _try_pending_coupon(): a code captured by the /coupon/<code> share link is stashed in request.session['pending_coupon_code'] and replayed on the next cart recompute, auto-applying it when it yields a single non-multi-product reward. Errors/successes flow into session keys (error_promo_code / successful_code / pending_coupon_code) that the storefront templates surface. This code resolution, session replay and row-locking are invisible in field metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: sale.order._update_programs_and_rewards + _auto_apply_rewards recomputed on every cart change
behavioral_notes.observation: Reward and automatic-discount lines are NOT stored statically -- they are recomputed whenever the cart mutates. The module hooks every website_sale recompute path: _recompute_cart, _verify_cart_after_update, the Cart.cart controller, _set_delivery_method and _remove_delivery_line all call order._update_programs_and_rewards() (re-evaluates applicable programs/points and rewrites reward lines) then _auto_apply_rewards() (claims any program whose single reward is non-nominative, non-multi-product, not in disabled_auto_rewards and not already on the order). _cart_find_product_line filters out is_reward_line so standard add-to-cart never touches a reward line; deleting a reward line via _cart_update_order_line(qty<=0) sets context website_sale_loyalty_delete=True so sale.order.line.unlink() records the reward into disabled_auto_rewards (blocking immediate re-auto-claim). _compute_website_order_line merges multiple per-tax discount lines from one program into a single tax-free display line (one '10% discount' row), and _compute_cart_info subtracts reward-line quantities from cart_quantity. The reward set is thus a continuously derived projection of programs x current cart -- not in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: controllers/main.py routes: /coupon/<code>, /shop/claimreward, pricelist override (coupon entry & reward claim)
behavioral_notes.observation: Three public storefront entry points drive promotions. (1) The overridden pricelist route is the coupon-entry endpoint behind the cart's 'Gift card or discount code' form (input name='promo'): it runs _try_apply_code, calls _apply_reward on a single resolved reward, and redirects to post['r'] (default /shop/cart) with a success/error session flag. (2) /coupon/<string:code> (auth=public) is the shareable link built by the coupon.share wizard (base_url/coupon/<code>?r=<redirect>): it stores the code as pending and applies it immediately if a cart exists, else defers it until the cart is non-empty, encoding notify_coupon / coupon_error into the redirect query. (3) /shop/claimreward (auth=public) backs the per-reward 'Claim' buttons in the cart: it browses loyalty.reward sudo, validates against _get_claimable_and_showable_rewards() (which also surfaces the partner's nominative loyalty/gift cards holding enough unexpired points), captures product_id for multi-product rewards, and applies the reward (routing code-triggered programs back through pricelist). _apply_reward also re-rates free-over shipping after a non-payment reward. These controller flows and their session-error plumbing are not in Python field metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: gift-card / eWallet balance use at checkout (/wallet/top_up, payment override, delivery discount)
behavioral_notes.observation: Gift cards and eWallets are loyalty payment programs (program.is_payment_program) consumed as cart discount/payment lines. /wallet/top_up (auth=user) adds the eWallet trigger product (by trigger_product_id) to the cart so the customer can buy/recharge a wallet, then redirects to /shop/cart. At payment time PaymentPortal._validate_transaction_for_order re-runs _update_programs_and_rewards just before finalizing and raises ValidationError ('applied reward was changed or has expired') if the order total moved -- guarding a gift-card/discount whose value changed mid-checkout. _get_non_delivery_lines excludes shipping reward lines and _get_free_shipping_lines isolates 'shipping'-type rewards so free-shipping promos discount the carrier line; the delivery controller and the Checkout.prototype patch feed amount_delivery_discounted / discount_reward_amounts into the order summary so wallet, gift-card and discount amounts render live in the cart. product.product overrides expose unpublished reward/gift-card images and a gift_card.png placeholder to public users. _gc_abandoned_coupons (autovacuum) strips applied_coupon_ids from draft website orders idle > N days. These payment-time guards and balance mechanics are invisible in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (JS public.interactions + Checkout patch + website-builder option)
behavioral_notes.observation: 4 JS files, 2 XML templates, 0 OWL components. The storefront uses two public.interactions rather than OWL: CouponToaster (selector .coupon-message) turns the templates' hidden coupon-info/error/warning divs into success/danger/warning notifications after a code attempt, and GiftCardCopy (.o_purchased_gift_card .copy-to-clipboard) copies a purchased gift-card code to the clipboard. Checkout.prototype is patched (_updateCartSummary) to live-update the shipping-reward and discount-reward amounts in the cart summary, reloading the page when the number of discount lines changes. A coupon_option website-builder plugin (website.website_builder_assets) lets editors toggle the promo-code box on the cart. Asset bundles: web.assets_frontend (2), web.assets_tests (1), website.website_builder_assets (1). These JS surfaces and the registry registrations are not in Python metadata.

it_architecture.application: website_sale_loyalty (eCommerce coupons, promotions, gift cards & loyalty -- the promotions layer of the website storefront)
logical_data_erm: sale.order.line -> loyalty.reward / loyalty.card (reward_id / coupon_id, is_reward_line) [from sale_loyalty]
information_flows: depends: website_sale, website_links, sale_loyalty (auto_install with website_sale + sale_loyalty)
inbound: shopper enters promo/coupon code at /shop cart -> sale.order._try_apply_code resolves rule/coupon -> applied_coupon_ids + reward lines
inbound: /coupon/<code> share link (built by coupon.share + website_links link.tracker) -> session pending_coupon_code -> replayed on next cart recompute
side-effect: every cart mutation -> _update_programs_and_rewards + _auto_apply_rewards rewrite reward & automatic-discount lines
side-effect: /wallet/top_up -> adds eWallet trigger product to cart; gift-card/eWallet balance applied as discount/payment line
guard: PaymentPortal._validate_transaction_for_order re-applies programs pre-payment and blocks the tx if the total changed
outbound display: delivery controller + Checkout.prototype patch -> amount_delivery_discounted / discount_reward_amounts into cart summary
autovacuum: _gc_abandoned_coupons clears applied_coupon_ids from idle draft website orders
delegates rule-matching, point debit/credit and reward math to sale_loyalty / loyalty (not re-implemented here)

capabilities: Apply Coupons & Promo Codes in the Online Cart (code entry, validation, auto-replay of shared codes)
Auto-Apply & Recompute Promotions on Cart Change (automatic discounts, reward lines)
Claim Rewards in the Storefront (discounts, free products, free shipping)
Pay / Top-up with Gift Cards & eWallets at eCommerce Checkout
Publish & Scope Promotion Programs to a Website (ecommerce_ok, website_id)
Generate Shareable Coupon Links for Marketing Campaigns
value_streams: Shop-to-Conversion (promotions): browse -> add to cart -> enter/auto-apply code or claim reward -> programs & rewards recomputed -> gift-card/eWallet/discount reduces total -> checkout & pay
Campaign-to-Cart: configure website program -> share /coupon/<code> link -> shopper lands on /shop -> pending code applied on first cart add
(realized end-to-end with website_sale checkout + sale_loyalty/loyalty rule engine + payment)
information_concepts: sale.order (eCommerce cart, applied coupons & reward lines)
loyalty.program (website-published promotion / gift card / eWallet / loyalty)
products: product.product (reward / gift-card backing product, image & placeholder exposed to public users)
product.product (eWallet trigger / top-up product added via /wallet/top_up)
policies: 1 access rule (coupon.share wizard); no record rules / groups of its own (inherits website + loyalty scoping)
promo-code uniqueness per website: _constrains_code allows the same code on different websites but not two reachable from one website, and bars coupon/program code clash
website scoping: only ecommerce_ok programs matching website_id (or website_id=False) apply in the cart
checkout integrity: payment blocked (ValidationError) if the applied reward/total changed after re-evaluation
deleting an auto-reward line disables its re-auto-claim (disabled_auto_rewards)
abandoned-cart hygiene: _gc_abandoned_coupons autovacuum strips coupons from idle draft website orders
nominative programs only for logged-in (non-public) shoppers (_allow_nominative_programs)
stakeholders: Online shopper (res.partner / public user) entering codes & redeeming gift cards/eWallets
Marketing user designing website promotions and sharing coupon links
Website editor toggling the promo-code box (website builder)
Upstream engines: sale_loyalty / loyalty (rules & points) and payment (transactions)
metrics: applied_coupon_ids count / reward-line count per cart (conversion levers)
loyalty.program.total_order_count / coupon usage vs max_usage (program uptake, from loyalty)
gift-card / eWallet balance consumed at checkout (from loyalty.history)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: website_sale_loyalty is the promotions / mediation layer of the website_sale value network -- it lives inside the eCommerce storefront and exists to drive conversion, not merely to configure rules. Where the parent loyalty module is a cross-cutting rule engine (support), this module wires that engine into the live two-sided storefront (shoppers <-> the merchant's catalogue), mediating the buy decision with promo codes, auto-applied discounts, claimable rewards, shareable coupon links and gift-card/eWallet tender at checkout. That promotion/mediation role -- lowering the price barrier and creating switching-cost ties (stored-value wallets, points, shareable campaign links) to grow and retain the customer base -- is value-network logic (Stabell & Fjeldstad), and because it acts directly in the customer-facing sell channel it is a primary activity rather than firm infrastructure. APQC maps it to 3.0 Market and Sell (manage promotions / pricing applied at the online point of sale), distinct from the 3.5 order-management groups that website_sale / sale own; the actual money movement only lands on account.move downstream.

standard_capabilities: Promo-code / coupon entry box in the online cart with success/error toasts (input name='promo')
Automatic application & live recomputation of discounts and reward lines on every cart change
Per-reward 'Claim' buttons in the cart (/shop/claimreward) incl. free product, free shipping, multi-product choice
Shareable /coupon/<code> links (coupon.share wizard + website_links shortener) that pre-load a code into the cart
Gift cards and eWallets usable as payment at checkout, with /wallet/top_up to buy/recharge a wallet
Website-published & website-scoped programs (ecommerce_ok, website.multi.mixin), with editor toggle for the code box
Payment-time guard that re-validates rewards/total before finalizing the transaction
typical_fits: Percentage / fixed discount codes and auto-applied promotions in the storefront
Gift-card sale and redemption fully online; eWallet top-up & spend
Free-shipping promotions discounting the carrier line
Multi-website stores with per-website promotion scoping and campaign coupon links
common_gaps: Requires website_sale + sale_loyalty + payment installed and configured; does nothing standalone
Loyalty (points-earning nominative) cards apply but cannot be entered by code in the cart -- claimed only when logged in
Bespoke storefront promo UI/UX (banners, tiered offers) beyond the built-in cart box needs theme/dev work
External coupon-platform / affiliate-network or marketplace promotion sync (no outbound integration here)
Complex stacking / exclusivity rules beyond loyalty's built-in program logic
drive_hints: curl: POST /shop/claimreward with reward_id (+ product_id for multi-product) after building a cart session

open_questions: Exact stacking / priority order in which multiple website programs and auto-rewards combine on one cart (resolved inside sale_loyalty._update_programs_and_rewards, not here).
Whether a pending shared coupon (pending_coupon_code) can silently expire between landing on /shop and the first cart add.
How eWallet / gift-card partial balances are tracked across multiple website orders (loyalty.history vs. card points) and any double-spend protection beyond the pre-payment re-validation.
Interaction of website-scoped _constrains_code uniqueness with multi-website portals sharing one loyalty.program.
